messages.subject: Ext JS with R error
parts:
Hi all,

I have tried to read mysql data and converted that to JSON format in R and then returned the JSON output to Ext JS. But I am not be able to display the content in grid (with pagination) designed with Ext JS. I request your help. following are my codes. I hope I am returning R output in proper way to ext js.

R script:

<%
library(RJSONIO);
con <- dbConnect("MySQL", host="localhost", user ="root", dbname = "myDB")
rs1 <- dbGetQuery(con, "select * from strawhats;")
xy.list <- vector("list", nrow(rs1))
total <- nrow(rs1);
for (i in 1:nrow(rs1)) {
        xy.list[[i]] <- rs1[i,]
}
y<-toJSON(xy.list)

x <- paste("({",'"total"',":",as.character(total),',"results"',":",y,"})", sep="")
return(x);
#print(x)
dbDisconnect(con)
%>


Ext JS:
Ext.onReady(function(){
    // create the data store
    var store = new Ext.data.JsonStore({
                totalProperty: 'total', // total data, see json output
                root: 'results',        // see json output
                url: 'paging-grid-data.R',
        fields: [
           {name: 'id', type: 'int'},
           {name:'name'},
           {name:'position'},
           {name:'ambition'}
        ]
    });
        // load data from the url ( data.php ) and add start and limit parameter
        store.load({params:{start: 0, limit: 3}});
    // create the Grid
    var grid = new Ext.grid.GridPanel({
        store: store,
        columns: [
            {id:'id',header: "ID", width: 30, sortable: true, dataIndex: 'id'},
                        {header: 'Name', width: 100, sortable: true, dataIndex: 'name'},
                        {header: 'Position', width: 100, sortable: true, dataIndex: 'position'},
                        {header: 'Ambition', width: 250, sortable: true, dataIndex: 'ambition'}
        ],
        stripeRows: true,
        height:250,
        width:500,
        title:'Paging Grid',
                bbar: new Ext.PagingToolbar({
                        pageSize: 10,   // data to display
                        store: store,
                        displayInfo: true,
                        displayMsg: 'Displaying topics {0} - {1} of {2}',
                        emptyMsg: "No topics to display"
                })
    });
        // render this grid to paging-grid element
    grid.render('paging-grid');
});
